rag_summary_count_consistency.details: The identified_bias_summary totals four occurrences, matching the four identified_occurrences records; all listed labels have count one. The single candidate is separately represented in candidate_biases.

evaluation_limitations: The supplied evaluation segment map is null, so the four decision-point segments were generated from the raw interview and generation specification rather than prevalidated.
The actual retrieved corpus chunks or retrieval logs were not supplied; corpus fidelity cannot be independently scored.

Retrospective self-report and operational time pressure can support non-bias interpretations, so ambiguous alert-triage evidence is retained as a candidate rather than promoted to an identified occurrence.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The new CVE was moved to the top of the queue and routed to the usual web-application remediation queue while the older database finding remained in place; the participant cited the fresh breach and the frequent injection-ticket pattern.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The segment contains comparative prioritization influenced by the recent breach (Recency) and initial categorization influenced by the frequently encountered web-application ticket pattern (Availability Frequency).

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: While cross-referencing assets, the participant saw a low-confidence privilege-escalation alert, relied on its historically benign resolution pattern, and did not consciously register the adjacent anomalous outbound-traffic entry.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The segment contains memory-based weighting of a familiar alert label (Availability Frequency) and failure to register a visually available cue during a competing task (Selective Attention Bias or Inattentional Blindness).

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The emergency change-window justification emphasized contract exposure, reputational fallout, and audit risk, even though the EPSS probability was moderate and comparable to findings handled in the normal weekend cycle.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant explicitly said that loss-oriented framing changed the felt urgency while the underlying EPSS score and disruption remained constant (Loss Framing).

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The participant scoped the patch ticket to the two hosts shown in the scanner's default view, treated that list as complete, and did not manually cross-check the inventory containing three additional affected hosts.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The available option set was implicitly limited to the scanner's default-view hosts, without checking the alternative inventory view (Exposure to limited alternatives).

segment_level_adjudications.localization_basis: Both identified findings quote or substantively describe the CVE prioritization and routing episode in this segment.
segment_level_adjudications.adjudication_note: The segment is detected at moderate confidence through two identified findings, although only the recency finding has a full mechanism match and both recency and categorization labels are neighboring rather than exact target labels.

segment_level_adjudications.localization_basis: The candidate quote directly addresses the low-confidence SIEM alert and is localized to the same alert-triage episode; no identified occurrence is localized here.
segment_level_adjudications.adjudication_note: The candidate preserves a plausible Availability Frequency mechanism for cb_03 but does not establish the attentional failure in cb_04 and is not promoted to an identified strict match.

segment_level_adjudications.localization_basis: The identified occurrence uses exact participant quotations about the change-window justification and the unchanged EPSS score and disruption.
segment_level_adjudications.adjudication_note: This is an exact or established-equivalent label, location, and mechanism match at moderate confidence.

segment_level_adjudications.localization_basis: The identified occurrence quotes the scanner default-view decision, the absence of a manual inventory check, and the missed host.
segment_level_adjudications.adjudication_note: The episode is correctly localized, but automation complacency is a neighboring/different construct from the hidden limited-alternatives target and the stated causal mechanism is not full.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Prioritization of the new CVE over the older database finding
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: A recent, vivid breach report primes a matching category and makes the new CVE seem more urgent than the older objectively severe finding.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: Availability heuristic is a near-neighbor label: the reported mechanism is specifically temporal salience of the recent breach, which is the hidden Recency target.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The occurrence explicitly links the fresh breach, its similarity to the CVE, and the resulting urgency differential over the older finding.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: Evidence is faithfully quoted and localized to the prioritization episode; hindsight is used only as counterevidence, not as the basis for credit.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Initial routing of the new CVE to a remediation queue
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: High historical frequency of web-application tickets makes that category easiest to recall and causes miscategorization of a technically distinct CVE.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: Representativeness heuristic is a neighboring categorization label, but the quoted evidence and occurrence description explicitly rely on the frequent ticket pattern and its ease of recall.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The finding captures the high-frequency familiar category, the first-to-mind effect, the ignored diagnostic advisory cue, and the resulting misrouting.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The quoted evidence is accurate and supports the mechanism at the intake decision point.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Disposition of the low-confidence privilege-escalation SIEM alert
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Frequent benign resolution of the alert label makes benign the easiest-recalled outcome and overrides specific diagnostic evidence of an active threat.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: The proposed automation-complacency label is not the target label; the candidate's cry-wolf alternative is a near-neighbor interpretation of the frequency-based mechanism.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The candidate directly describes repeated false-positive history making the benign outcome easiest to recall, but its own uncertainty prevents identified-level credit.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The candidate quote is faithful and correctly localized; the transcript also contains a specific unusual timestamp and competing-task explanation, so promotion to identified status would overstate certainty.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_target_bias_label: Selective Attention Bias or Inattentional Blindness
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Failure to register the anomalous outbound-traffic entry during asset cross-referencing
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Narrow focus on the inventory task prevents conscious registration of a visually available cue in the same dashboard view.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: No RAG finding identifies the failure to register the adjacent outbound-traffic cue.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: No RAG finding supplies the required visual-attention mechanism.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: No prediction was made; the raw interview supports the hidden instance through the participant's explicit uncertainty and task-focused account.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Loss-oriented representation of equivalent risk information increases urgency relative to a gain or routine-maintenance frame.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: Framing effect is an established broader label that covers the explicitly described loss-versus-gain framing manipulation.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The finding preserves the same EPSS probability and disruption while showing that loss language changed the participant's urgency judgment.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The finding uses exact quotations and appropriately notes the organizational approval incentive as counterevidence without eliminating the self-reported framing effect.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Final scope confirmation for the patch target list
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: The scanner's default-view host list is treated as exhaustive, so alternatives visible only after a manual inventory filter change are not generated or considered.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: Automation complacency is a related explanation for failing to verify the scanner, but it is not equivalent to the hidden option-set/limited-alternatives construct.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The same omission and missed hosts are captured, but the RAG explanation centers on overtrust in automation rather than failure to generate the alternative inventory view; therefore overlap is substantial, not full.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The quoted evidence is accurate and correctly localized; the later audit result is used as outcome context rather than hindsight proof of the bias.

unmatched_rag_predictions.why_not_an_exact_strict_match: The occurrence is moderate confidence and uses availability heuristic rather than the hidden Recency label; its temporal-salience mechanism is nevertheless a full mechanism match.
The occurrence uses representativeness heuristic rather than Availability Frequency, although its evidence explicitly describes the frequent familiar category becoming first to mind.
The finding correctly describes the default scanner output and missed inventory hosts, but automation overtrust is not the same causal construct as exposure to a limited set of alternatives.

It is explicitly retained as a candidate, not an identified occurrence, and its proposed automation-complacency label is not the target Availability Frequency label; its alternative cry-wolf explanation captures the frequency mechanism.

candidates.details: The candidate correctly preserves the repeated-benign-history mechanism for cb_03, but the transcript supports a reasonable non-bias triage interpretation and does not establish the claim at identified confidence.

high_only.detection_interpretation: No findings met the high-confidence threshold; all four positive segments were missed.

corpus_support_audit.assessment_note: The RAG claims corpus support for obs_004 and supplies one source passage, while obs_001 through obs_003 disclose no retrieved support. Because the actual retrieved material and logs are absent, the supplied citation cannot be independently verified and no primary corpus-fidelity score is calculated.

confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_to_high_and_moderate: At the recommended threshold, segment detection rises from 0/4 to 3/4; strict instance F1 rises from undefined to 0.2000, while mechanism-first F1 rises from undefined to 0.6000.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_and_moderate_to_all_: No change: all four identified occurrences are moderate confidence.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_all_confidence_to_all_con: The candidate tier adds one segment hit and one mechanism-first instance true positive, but adds one strict false positive; strict F1 decreases to 0.1818 and mechanism-first F1 rises to 0.7273.

overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: At high_and_moderate, the RAG detects 3 of 4 positive reasoning segments with no false alarms (hit rate 0.7500; F1 0.8571).
overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: At high_and_moderate, strict scoring yields 1 true positive, 5 false negatives, and 3 false positives (precision 0.2500; recall 0.1667; F1 0.2000).
overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: At high_and_moderate, mechanism-first scoring yields 3 true positives, 3 false negatives, and 1 false positive (precision 0.7500; recall 0.5000; F1 0.6000).
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: The candidate is a useful abstention: at the fourth threshold it recovers the alert-triage segment and the cb_03 mechanism under mechanism-first scoring, but it is not a strict identified match.
main_failure_modes: Two identified findings use neighboring labels rather than the hidden Recency and Availability Frequency labels.
The RAG does not identify the selective-attention/inattentional-blindness instance.
The automation-complacency finding is correctly localized to the scoping episode but does not capture the hidden limited-alternatives construct as a full mechanism.
The candidate does not distinguish the alert-history mechanism from the concurrent-task attentional failure.
main_strengths: All four identified findings are faithfully localized to real interview episodes.
The loss-framing finding is an exact or established-equivalent match with strong evidence.
Three identified findings preserve mechanisms that are more informative than their strict taxonomy labels suggest.
The candidate tier appropriately expresses uncertainty rather than overstating ambiguous evidence.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This run shows strong segment-level coverage at moderate confidence but substantially weaker strict instance-level performance because the RAG taxonomy diverges from the hidden labels. Mechanism-first scoring materially improves identification, and the candidate tier recovers one additional mechanism without falsely converting the ambiguous alert evidence into a fully identified strict bias.
